2026 · Python · LangGraph · MCP · Ollama

Intent OSIntent OS

把意图编译成可验证、可回滚的执行链Compiling intent into verifiable, rollback-safe chains

它不是一个 agent，也不是另一个 agent 框架。它是一层运行在 LLM 之上的 runtime：意图先被编译成带验收标准的 Plan DAG，副作用必须经过按风险分级的审批闸门，每一次回执都写进哈希链审计日志。换掉底下的 agent，这一层不变。Not an agent, and not another agent framework — a runtime layer above the LLM. Intent compiles into a Plan DAG with acceptance criteria, side effects pass a risk-tiered approval gate, and every receipt lands in a hash-chained audit log. Swap the agent underneath; this layer stays.

技术栈Stack

  • Python
  • LangGraph
  • MCP
  • Ollama

亮点Highlights

  1. 意图 → 结构化 Plan DAG，每个节点自带验收标准Intent compiles into a Plan DAG where every node carries acceptance criteria

  2. 副作用按风险分级审批，失败可回滚Risk-tiered approval gate for side effects, with rollback on failure

  3. 哈希链审计日志：可验证、可重放、可封存Hash-chained audit log — verifiable, replayable, sealable

  4. 弹性改道，单步失败不会拖死整条链Elastic rerouting so one failed step doesn't stall the whole run
